top_signals.title: Bank rate increased to 4% - November 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
top_signals.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
top_signals.summary: The project warned that installations running older versions were vulnerable and urged operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Widespread PHP Flaw May Cause Many Site Outages Today
top_signals.summary: Expect to see quite a few websites serving "404" or "Page Not Found" errors today: Nearly 70 percent of websites need to update their core software to fix a pair of vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to seize full control over affected servers. Experts say there are working exploits for the flaws, and that these critical bugs are already being exploited in the wild.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
